definitions.explanation: Something that cannot be understood or explained, despite efforts to make sense of it.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{行動|こうどう}は{不可解|ふかかい}だ。
{不可解|ふかかい}な{事件|じけん}が{起|お}きた。
なぜ{断|ことわ}ったのか{不可解|ふかかい}でならない。
examples.english: I simply can't understand why they refused.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{不|ふ} (un-, in-) + {可|か} (possible) + {解|かい} (understand)
Literally: "impossible to understand"

FORMS:
・{不可解|ふかかい}な + noun (incomprehensible ~)
・{不可解|ふかかい}だ (it's puzzling)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{不可解|ふかかい}な{行動|こうどう} - incomprehensible behavior
・{不可解|ふかかい}な{事件|じけん} - mysterious incident
・{不可解|ふかかい}な{死|し} - mysterious death

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{不思議|ふしぎ} - strange, mysterious (more neutral, can be positive)
・{不可思議|ふかしぎ} - inexplicable (more literary)
・{謎|なぞ}めいた - enigmatic, mysterious

REGISTER:
Formal to neutral. Often used in news and serious writing.
